shared_elements: human or anthropomorphic figure with arms raised/bent upward
justification: Both depict schematic frontal anthropomorphic figures with arms raised or bent up beside the head, rendered as simple incised outlines, and both include circular elements (small discs/cupules in A, prominent concentric circles on the torso in B). But A is a multi-figure scene of stick-like full-body figures with long legs among lines and dots, while B is a single bust-like figure whose body is covered with an ordered array of discs, pendants and a belt-like band, so the compositions and the treatment of body ornament differ fundamentally.
